choices.B: 対向車のライトの少し右側を見て、道路の端やフォグライン（車道外側線）を見る。
choices.C: 眩しさに対抗するためにハイビームを点灯する。
choices.D: 車が通り過ぎるまで片目を閉じる。

ja.explanation: 夜間にヘッドライトの眩しさで目が眩むのを軽減するには、対向車のライトの少し右側を見て、道路の端やフォグライン（車道外側線）を見るようにします。

ja.question: 霧、土埃、または煙の中を運転する際は、どのヘッドライトを使用すべきですか？

choices.A: ハイビーム
choices.B: ロービーム
choices.C: パーキングライトのみ
choices.D: ハザードランプのみ

ja.explanation: 霧、土埃、煙、または視界の悪い場所を運転する場合は、ハイビームの光が反射して眩しさを引き起こすため、ロービームのヘッドライトを使用してください。

ja.question: 濡れた路面や雪、氷の上を運転する際、使用しては「いけない」車の機能は何ですか？

choices.A: ワイパー
choices.B: ロービーム
choices.C: デフロスター
choices.D: クルーズコントロール

ja.explanation: マニュアルには「濡れた路面ではクルーズコントロールを使用しないでください」と明記されており、雪や氷の中での運転についてもこの警告が繰り返されています。

ja.question: 水溜まりを走行した後にブレーキが濡れてしまった場合、どうすればよいですか？

choices.A: ブレーキを乾かすために、何度も急ブレーキをかける。
choices.B: ブレーキが効き始めるまで、ゆっくり走行しながら軽くブレーキをかける。
choices.C: ニュートラルに入れ、ブレーキが乾くまで惰性で走行する。
choices.D: すぐに車を停止させ、ブレーキが自然に乾くのを待つ。

ja.explanation: 水溜まりを走行してブレーキが濡れた場合は、ブレーキが効き始めるまで、ゆっくり走行しながら軽くブレーキをかける必要があります。

ja.question: 雪や氷に覆われた道路が最も滑りやすくなるのはいつですか？

choices.A: 気温が氷点下よりずっと低い時。
choices.B: 気温が氷点（0度）付近の時。
choices.C: 日の出前の早朝の時間帯。
choices.D: 太陽が氷に直接当たっている時。

ja.explanation: マニュアルでは、気温が氷点下よりずっと低い時よりも、氷点（0度）付近の時の方が道路が最も滑りやすくなることに注意するよう運転手にアドバイスしています。

ja.question: 車がスリップ（スキッド）し始めた場合、正しいハンドルの操作はどれですか？

choices.A: ハンドルを完全にまっすぐに保つ。
choices.B: スリップしている方向とは逆の方向にハンドルを切る。
choices.C: 車を進めたい方向にハンドルを切る。
choices.D: トラクションを取り戻すために、ハンドルを左右に急に切る。

ja.explanation: 車がスリップし始めたら、ブレーキから足を離し、車を進めたい方向にハンドルを切る必要があります。

ja.question: オレゴン州において、スパイクタイヤの使用が一般的に許可されているのは何月から何月までですか？

choices.A: 10月1日から4月30日まで
choices.B: 11月1日から3月31日まで
choices.C: 12月1日から2月28日まで
choices.D: 一年中許可されている。

ja.explanation: オレゴン州では、スパイクタイヤの使用は一般的に11月1日から3月31日までの間のみ許可されています。

ja.question: オレゴン州において、18歳未満の運転者の携帯電話使用に関する規則はどれですか？

choices.A: ハンズフリーのアクセサリーを使用してもよい。
choices.B: 赤信号で停車している間に限り、テキストメッセージを送信できる。
choices.C: 車両の運転中に携帯電話やその他のモバイル電子機器を使用することは違法である。
choices.D: GPSナビゲーションの目的に限り、携帯電話を使用してもよい。

ja.explanation: マニュアルには、18歳未満の運転者が車両の運転中に携帯電話やその他のモバイル電子機器を使用することは違法であると記載されています。

ja.question: 運転中に携帯電話を使用したい18歳以上の運転者は、以下のどれを行わなければなりませんか？

choices.A: 携帯電話を膝の上に置く。
choices.B: 指を最小限に使うだけで済むハンズフリーのアクセサリーを使用する。
choices.C: 時速30マイル（約48km/h）未満で運転している間に限り、携帯電話を使用する。
choices.D: 電話に出るために路肩に車を寄せる。

ja.explanation: 18歳以上の運転者が携帯電話を使用する場合はハンズフリーのアクセサリーを使用しなければならず、機器の起動や停止には指を最小限に使うだけで済むものでなければなりません。

ja.question: 車両からどれくらい離れた距離で聞こえるほど、ラジオや音響システムを大音量で鳴らすことは違法ですか？

choices.A: 25フィート（約7.6メートル）
choices.B: 50フィート（約15メートル）
choices.C: 100フィート（約30メートル）
choices.D: 200フィート（約60メートル）

ja.explanation: クラクションやサイレンの音を聞き取ることが重要であるため、車両から50フィート離れた場所で聞こえるほどラジオやその他の音響システムを大音量で鳴らすことは違法です。

ja.question: 「ロードレイジ（あおり運転などの攻撃的な運転）」をしている攻撃的な運転者に遭遇した場合、どうすべきですか？

choices.A: スピードを上げて逃げる。
choices.B: クラクションを鳴らして他の運転者に警告する。
choices.C: 道を譲り、相手を刺激しないようにする。
choices.D: 相手より速く運転して安全な場所に向かう。

ja.explanation: 攻撃的な運転者を見かけたら、道を譲ってください。スピードを上げたり、相手より速く走ろうとしたりして、相手を刺激してはいけません。

ja.question: 運転中の眠気を防ぐために推奨されているのは、次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: できるだけ早く目的地まで無理して運転を続ける。
choices.B: 脱水症状を防ぐために水を飲む。
choices.C: ラジオの音量を最大にする。
choices.D: 視線をまっすぐ前に固定する。

ja.explanation: 眠気を防ぐため、マニュアルでは水を飲むことを推奨しています。脱水症状は疲労の原因となるためです。

ja.question: オレゴン州法において、血中アルコール濃度（BAC）がどれ以上の場合、運転能力が低下しているとみなされ、飲酒・薬物影響下運転（DUII）で逮捕される可能性がありますか？
ja.explanation: 血中アルコール濃度が0.08%以上の場合、オレゴン州法では運転能力が低下しているとみなされます。

ja.question: オレゴン州の「黙示の同意（Implied Consent）法」とは何を意味しますか？

choices.A: 車を止められた場合、車両の捜索に同意する。
choices.B: 警察官に求められた場合、呼気、血液、または尿の検査を受けることに同意する。
choices.C: DUIIで逮捕された場合、自動的に有罪を認める。
choices.D: 交通違反切符に関連するすべての罰金を支払うことに同意する。

ja.explanation: オレゴン州の黙示の同意法は、自動車を運転することにより、警察官から求められた際に呼気、血液、または尿の検査を受けることに同意したとみなされることを意味します。

ja.question: 21歳未満の場合、血中アルコール濃度がどれくらいであれば血中アルコール検査に不合格となりますか？

choices.D: 検出された場合（いかなる量でも）

ja.explanation: オレゴン州のゼロ・トレランス（絶対不容認）法により、21歳未満の場合は、いかなる量でも血中アルコール濃度が検出されれば検査に不合格となります。

ja.question: オレゴン州の「開栓済み容器（Open Container）法」によると、開栓されたアルコールの瓶や容器は車内のどこに保管すべきですか？

choices.A: グローブボックスの中
choices.B: 運転席の下
choices.C: トランクの中
choices.D: 後部座席の足元

ja.explanation: オレゴン州の開栓済み容器法では、開栓された瓶や容器はトランクに入れなければならないと定められています。

ja.question: オレゴン州法では、何歳未満の人が車のボンネット、フェンダー、またはピックアップトラックの荷台に乗ることを禁止していますか？

choices.D: 年齢制限はない（すべての人が違法である）

ja.explanation: オレゴン州法では、18歳未満の人が車のボンネット、フェンダー、ランニングボード、またはピックアップトラックの荷台を含む車両の外部に乗ることを禁止しています。

ja.question: 運転中にタイヤがパンク（バースト）した場合、最初にすべきことは何ですか？

choices.A: すぐに急ブレーキをかける。
choices.B: ハンドルをしっかりと握る。
choices.C: ニュートラルにシフトチェンジする。
choices.D: ハザードランプを点灯させる。

ja.explanation: タイヤがパンクした場合、マニュアルでは、まずハンドルをしっかりと握り、その後徐々に減速して道路脇に車を停めるよう指示しています。

ja.question: 運転中にブレーキが効かなくなった場合、次のうちどのアクションを取るべきですか？

choices.A: より高いギアにシフトチェンジする。
choices.B: すぐにエンジンを切る。
choices.C: ブレーキペダルを何度も踏み込んで（ポンピングブレーキ）、圧力を高める。
choices.D: できるだけ早くパーキングブレーキを引く。

ja.explanation: ブレーキが効かなくなった場合は、ブレーキペダルを何度も踏み込んで（ポンピングブレーキ）ください。これにより十分な圧力がかかり、再びブレーキが効くようになる可能性があります。

ja.question: 車のアクセルペダルが戻らなくなった（引っかかった）場合、どうすればよいですか？

choices.A: 開いた手のひらを使って、ギアをニュートラルに入れる。
choices.B: すぐにエンジンを切る。
choices.C: アクセルペダルを素早く何度も踏み込む。
choices.D: リバース（後退）にシフトチェンジする。

ja.explanation: アクセルが戻らなくなった場合は、退避経路を探し、誤って他のギアに入れないように、開いた手のひらを使ってギアをニュートラルに入れてください。

ja.question: 燃費を向上させ、燃料を節約するために推奨されるテクニックは次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: 急発進や急ブレーキを行う。
choices.B: エンジンを温かく保つためにアイドリングする。
choices.C: 一定の速度で運転し、標識の制限速度を超えないようにする。
choices.D: 用事のために何度も別々に車を出す。

ja.explanation: 燃費を向上させたり燃料を節約したりするために、マニュアルでは一定の速度で運転し、標識の制限速度を超えないようにすることを推奨しています。

ja.question: 運転中に携帯電話にテキストメッセージを受信した場合、どうすればよいですか？

choices.A: すばやくメッセージを読んで返信する。
choices.B: 安全な駐車場に車を停めるまでメッセージを無視する。
choices.C: 自分が入力している間、同乗者にメッセージを読んでもらう。
choices.D: 減速し、道路から目を離さずにメッセージを読む。

ja.explanation: マニュアルには、運転中に携帯電話にテキストメッセージを受信した場合、安全な駐車場に車を停めるまでメッセージを無視すべきであると記載されています。

ja.question: クラスCの非商用運転免許（Class C non-commercial driving privilege）では、重量が何ポンド以下の車両を運転できますか？
ja.explanation: クラスCの非商用運転免許では、商用運転免許（CDL）やオートバイの免許区分（endorsement）の要件が免除されている、重量26,000ポンド以下の車両を運転することができます。

ja.question: オレゴン州で仮免許（instruction permit）を申請するために必要な最低年齢は何歳ですか？
ja.explanation: クラスCの非商用運転免許の資格を得るには、仮免許を申請する時点で15歳以上である必要があります。

ja.question: オレゴン州運輸省（ODOT）が承認した交通安全教育コースを受講していない18歳未満の申請者には、何時間の監督付き運転経験が必要ですか？

choices.A: 40時間
choices.B: 50時間
choices.C: 80時間
choices.D: 100時間

ja.explanation: 18歳未満の申請者は、100時間の監督付き運転経験が必要です。ただし、ODOTが承認した交通安全教育コースを受講した場合は、50時間の監督付き運転経験で済みます。

ja.question: 必要な運転経験としてカウントされるためには、監督するドライバーが21歳以上であり、かつ有効な運転免許を少なくとも何年間保持している必要がありますか？

choices.A: 1年間
choices.B: 2年間
choices.C: 3年間
choices.D: 5年間

ja.explanation: 運転経験がカウントされるのは、21歳以上で、有効な運転免許を少なくとも3年間保持している人が監督した場合のみです。

ja.question: オレゴン州の運転免許証（driving privilege）用の写真を撮影する際、許可されていないものは次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: 笑顔
choices.B: 補聴器の着用
choices.C: 眼鏡の着用
choices.D: 髪を後ろで束ねること

ja.explanation: 写真撮影の際、帽子、眼鏡、顔のペイントやその他の一時的な物質、または目の外観を変えるコンタクトレンズの着用は許可されていません。

ja.question: 身元および生年月日を証明する有効な書類は、次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: 病院発行の出生証明書
choices.B: 洗礼記録
choices.C: 10年前に失効した米国パスポート
choices.D: 米国政府発行の出生証明書

ja.explanation: 有効な証明書類には、米国政府発行の出生証明書が含まれます。病院発行の出生証明書や洗礼記録は認められず、パスポートは失効から5年以上経過しているものは使用できません。

ja.question: 現在の居住地住所の有効な証明となるものは、次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: 友人からの個人的な郵便物
choices.B: 転送された郵便物
choices.C: 公共料金の接続申込書または請求書
choices.D: 姓が記載されていない雑誌の定期購読物

ja.explanation: 一般的な住所証明には、公共料金の接続申込書、請求書、住宅ローン書類、または固定資産税の明細書が含まれます。個人的な郵便物や転送された郵便物は認められません。

ja.question: 運転免許証または許可証に「聴覚障害または難聴（Deaf or hard of hearing）」の指定を追加するには、どのような証明が必要ですか？

choices.A: 医師の診断書
choices.B: 認定専門医によるオージオグラム（聴力図）
choices.C: 裁判官が署名した用紙
choices.D: 証明は不要

ja.explanation: DMVに対し、運転免許証または許可証に聴覚障害または難聴の指定を追加するようリクエストすることができます。証明は必要ありません。

ja.question: オレゴン州において、1回の衝突事故につき義務付けられている対物賠償責任保険の最低補償額はいくらですか？
ja.explanation: オレゴン州法では、他人の財産に対する損害について、1回の衝突事故につき最低$20,000の保険に加入することが義務付けられています。

ja.question: 負傷者のいない衝突事故に巻き込まれた場合、自分の車両をどうするべきですか？

choices.A: 警察が到着するまで、そのままの場所に置いておく。
choices.B: 安全が確認でき次第、速やかに走行車線から移動させる。
choices.C: すぐに自宅まで運転し、後で警察に電話する。
choices.D: 車両を放置し、最寄りの電話まで歩く。

ja.explanation: 負傷者がおらず、車両を安全に移動できる場合は、できるだけ早く走行車線から車両を移動させなければなりません。

ja.question: いずれかの車両の損害額が$2,500を超え、かつ次の条件に当てはまる場合、72時間以内にDMVに衝突事故報告書を提出しなければなりません：

choices.A: 衝突事故が夜間に発生した。
choices.B: 相手の運転手が保険に加入していない。
choices.C: 損傷により、いずれかの車両が現場からレッカー移動された。
choices.D: 制限速度が55 mphを超えていた。

ja.explanation: いずれかの車両の損害額が$2,500を超え、かつ衝突による損傷のため現場からいずれかの車両がレッカー移動された場合、72時間以内に衝突事故報告書を提出しなければなりません。

ja.question: 無人の車両に衝突し、所有者が見つからない場合、どうしなければなりませんか？

choices.A: 誰も怪我をしていないので、すぐに現場を離れる。
choices.B: 現場を離れる前に、最長1時間車両のそばで待機する。
choices.C: 自分の名前、住所、および事故の簡単な説明を記したメモを残す。
choices.D: レッカー車を呼び、損傷した車両を撤去する。

ja.explanation: 無人の車両に衝突し、所有者が見つからない場合は、自分の名前と住所、および事故の簡単な説明を記したメモを残してください。

ja.question: オレゴン州で運転免許（driving privileges）を失う理由となるのは、次のうちどれですか？

choices.A: 車両の衝突事故の報告を怠ること。
choices.B: 1回の駐車違反切符を切られること。
choices.C: 20年以上前の車両を運転すること。
choices.D: 免許証を家に忘れること。

ja.explanation: 運転免許を失う理由には、車両の衝突事故の報告を怠ること、無保険での運転、および飲酒・薬物影響下での運転（DUI）が含まれます。

ja.question: 交通違反の有罪判決が多すぎることにより運転免許を失うことに関連するプログラムは何ですか？

choices.A: 交通更生システム (Traffic Rehabilitation System)
choices.B: 安全運転イニシアチブ (Safe Driver Initiative)
choices.C: 運転者改善プログラム (Driver Improvement Program)
choices.D: 有罪判決軽減プログラム (Conviction Reduction Program)

ja.explanation: マニュアルには、運転者改善プログラム（Driver Improvement Program）に基づき、交通違反の有罪判決が多すぎる場合は運転免許を失う可能性があると記載されています。

ja.question: 次のうち、影響下で運転すると運転免許を失う可能性があるものはどれですか？

choices.A: アルコールのみ
choices.B: 薬物のみ
choices.C: 処方薬のみ
choices.D: アルコール、薬物、または吸入剤

ja.explanation: アルコール、薬物、または吸入剤の影響下で運転した場合、運転免許を失う可能性があります。

ja.question: 次のどれに従わなかった場合、運転免許を失う可能性がありますか？

choices.A: 陪審員の召喚状
choices.B: 裁判所の罰金
choices.C: 車両登録更新の通知
choices.D: 町内会の規則

ja.explanation: 裁判所の罰金に従わないことは、運転免許を失う理由の一つとして挙げられています。

ja.question: マニュアルによると、どのような経済的保護を持たずに運転すると、運転免許を失う原因になりますか？

choices.A: 車両保険（総合補償）
choices.B: 無保険車傷害保険
choices.C: 自動車保険（無保険運転）
choices.D: ロードサービス

ja.explanation: 無保険での運転は、運転免許を失う理由の一つです。

ja.question: 誰かが人身売買の被害者であると疑い、犯罪が進行中であるのを目撃した場合、まず何をすべきですか？

choices.A: 介入するために密売人に近づく
choices.B: 911に電話する
choices.C: 目的地まで車両を追跡する
choices.D: ソーシャルメディアに投稿する

ja.explanation: 誰かが人身売買の被害者であると疑い、犯罪が進行中であるのを目撃した場合、マニュアルでは911に電話するよう指示しています。

ja.question: 人身売買の疑いについて通報する際、次のような「実行可能な情報（actionable information）」を提供する必要があります：

choices.A: あなた個人の運転記録
choices.B: 被害者の財務履歴
choices.C: 関与している車、ナンバープレート、および人物の特徴
choices.D: あなたの車両の登録番号

ja.explanation: 実行可能な情報には、時間、日付、場所、関与している車やトラックの特徴（メーカー、車種、色、ナンバープレート）、および人物の特徴が含まれます。

ja.question: マニュアルが人身売買の疑いがある者に近づかないよう警告しているのはなぜですか？

choices.A: 一般市民が密売人と話すことは違法だから
choices.B: 危険であり、密売人の起訴において問題を引き起こす可能性があるから
choices.C: 密売人は通常、お金を要求してくるから
choices.D: 誤って道案内をしてしまうかもしれないから

ja.explanation: 密売人に近づくことは、あなたや被害者にとって危険であるだけでなく、最終的な密売人の起訴において問題を引き起こす可能性があります。

ja.question: マニュアルによると、性的搾取のために売買される未成年者は：

choices.A: 助けを求めた場合にのみ被害者とみなされる
choices.B: オンラインで勧誘された場合は被害者とみなされない
choices.C: 常に人身売買の被害者である
choices.D: 地元のDMV（車両管理局）オフィスによって処理される

ja.explanation: マニュアルには「性的搾取のために売買される未成年者は、常に人身売買の被害者である」と明記されています。

ja.question: 飲酒運転を通報するには、何番に電話すべきですか？
ja.explanation: 「重要な連絡先情報」のセクションには、飲酒運転の通報先として911が記載されています。

ja.question: マニュアルによると、オレゴン州の道路情報はどこで確認できますか？

choices.A: OregonDMV.com
choices.B: TripCheck.com
choices.C: TATアプリ
choices.D: 人口動態記録局 (Vital Records office)

ja.explanation: 「重要な連絡先情報」のセクションには、道路情報としてTripCheck.comが記載されています。

ja.question: ポートランド地域外からDMV（車両管理局）に連絡する必要がある場合、どの番号を使用すべきですか？
ja.explanation: ポートランド地域外からのDMVの連絡先番号は503-945-5000です。

ja.question: 聴覚障害のある方がDMV（車両管理局）に連絡するために、州全域で利用できるサービスは何ですか？

choices.A: TripCheck.com
choices.B: Statewide Relay 711（州全域リレーサービス）
choices.C: 全米人身売買ホットライン (The National Human Trafficking Hotline)
choices.D: ODOT（オレゴン州運輸省）非差別チーム

ja.explanation: マニュアルの連絡先情報には、「TDD（聴覚障害者向け）.......................Statewide Relay 711」と記載されています。

ja.question: 人身売買の危険信号（レッドフラッグ）に関する情報を得るために、マニュアルがダウンロードを推奨しているアプリは何ですか？

choices.A: TripCheckアプリ
choices.B: TATアプリ
choices.C: ODOTアプリ
choices.D: DMV Nowアプリ

ja.explanation: マニュアルには、「人身売買の危険信号（レッドフラッグ）および詳細情報については、今すぐTATアプリをダウンロードしてください」と記載されています。

ja.question: オレゴン州の出生証明書に関する情報が必要な場合、どの窓口に連絡するべきですか？

choices.A: 運転改善プログラム (Driver Improvement Program)
choices.B: ODOT非差別チーム
choices.C: 人口動態記録局 (Vital Records)
choices.D: DMV運転プログラム

ja.explanation: マニュアルには、人口動態記録局—オレゴン州（出生証明書情報）の連絡先として971-673-1190が記載されています。

ja.question: この標識は何を意味していますか？

choices.A: 減速し、注意して進む
choices.B: 完全に停止する
choices.C: 対向車に道を譲る
choices.D: 他の車両がいる場合のみ停止する

ja.explanation: 赤い八角形の「STOP（止まれ）」の標識は、停止線、横断歩道、または交差点に進入する前に完全に停止しなければならないことを意味します。進行する前に、他の車両や歩行者がいないか確認してください。

ja.question: この標識は運転者に何を求めていますか？

choices.A: 完全に停止する
choices.B: 加速して交通に合流する
choices.C: 減速し、他の車両や歩行者に優先権を譲る
choices.D: 停止せずに進む

ja.explanation: 赤と白の三角形の「YIELD（ゆずれ）」の標識は、減速し、他の車両や歩行者に優先権（通行権）を譲らなければならないことを意味します。他の人や車が安全に通過できるように、必要に応じて停止しなければなりません。

ja.question: この標識は何を意味していますか？

choices.A: この先通行止め
choices.B: 駐車禁止
choices.C: この道路への進入禁止
choices.D: この先行き止まり

ja.explanation: 赤と白の「DO NOT ENTER（進入禁止）」の標識は、この標識が設置されている道路やランプに進入してはならないことを意味します。通常、高速道路の出口ランプや一方通行の道路など、進入すると対向車と衝突する危険がある場所に設置されています。

ja.question: この標識を見た場合、どうするべきですか？

choices.A: Uターンする
choices.B: 注意しながら運転を続ける
choices.C: 停止して後退するか、方向転換する（逆走しているため）
choices.D: 加速してそのエリアから素早く抜け出す

ja.explanation: 赤と白の「WRONG WAY（逆走）」の標識は、一方通行の道路や高速道路のランプで交通の流れに逆らって走行していることを意味します。直ちに停止し、安全に方向転換するか後退してください。

ja.question: この標識は何を示していますか？

choices.A: 左折専用
choices.B: 交通は一方向（左方向）にのみ流れる
choices.C: 中央分離帯の左側を通行する
choices.D: 左側に高速道路の出口がある

ja.explanation: 矢印が描かれた白黒の「ONE WAY（一方通行）」の標識は、この道路の交通が矢印の指す一方向にのみ進むことを示しています。

ja.question: この標識は何を禁止していますか？

choices.A: 右折
choices.B: 左折
choices.C: Uターン
choices.D: 他の車両の追い越し

ja.explanation: Uターンの矢印に斜線が引かれた白い規制標識は、この場所でのUターンが禁止されていることを意味します。

ja.question: この標識によって禁止されている行動は何ですか？

choices.A: 右折
choices.B: 左折
choices.C: Uターン
choices.D: 直進

ja.explanation: 左折の矢印に斜線が引かれた白い規制標識は、この交差点での左折が許可されていないことを意味します。

ja.question: この標識はどういう意味ですか？

choices.A: Uターン禁止
choices.B: 左折禁止
choices.C: 右折禁止
choices.D: 追い越し禁止

ja.explanation: 右折の矢印が斜線で消されている白い規制標識は、この場所での右折が禁止されていることを意味します。

ja.question: この標識は何を示していますか？

choices.A: この先、道路幅減少
choices.B: この区間では他の車両を追い越してはいけない
choices.C: この先、対面通行
choices.D: 右側通行

ja.explanation: 白黒のペナント型（三角旗型）の「NO PASSING ZONE（追い越し禁止区間）」標識は、このエリアで他の車両を追い越すことが禁止されていることを意味します。これは追い越し禁止区間の始まりを示しています。

ja.question: この標識は運転手に何を指示していますか？

choices.A: 右へ合流
choices.B: 右折専用
choices.C: 分離帯や障害物の右側を通行する
choices.D: この先、右車線減少

ja.explanation: 矢印が描かれた白い規制標識「KEEP RIGHT（右側通行）」は、交通島、中央分離帯、または障害物の右側を通行しなければならないことを意味します。

ja.question: 形と色から判断して、これはどの種類の標識ですか？

choices.A: 警戒標識
choices.B: 案内標識
choices.C: 規制標識
choices.D: 工事用標識

ja.explanation: 黒字で書かれた白い長方形の標識は規制標識です。制限速度の標識は、理想的な条件下でのそのエリアの法定最高速度を示しています。

ja.question: この黄色いひし形の標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: この先、動物園またはアニマルパーク
choices.B: このエリアでは鹿が頻繁に道路を横断する
choices.C: この先、狩猟エリア
choices.D: 近くに野生動物保護区がある

ja.explanation: 鹿のシルエットが描かれた黄色いひし形の標識は、このエリアで鹿が頻繁に道路を横断することを警告しています。減速し、特に明け方と夕暮れ時は動物に注意してください。

ja.question: この標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: この先、スクールゾーン
choices.B: この先、横断歩道
choices.C: 近くにハイキングコースがある
choices.D: この先、バス停

ja.explanation: 歩行者の図が描かれた黄色いひし形の標識は、この先に横断歩道があることを警告しています。道路を横断する歩行者のために停止する準備をしてください。

ja.question: この標識の形は何を示していますか？

choices.A: 踏切
choices.B: 工事区間
choices.C: スクールゾーンまたは学校横断歩道
choices.D: 病院ゾーン

ja.explanation: 五角形の蛍光黄緑色の標識は、スクールゾーンまたは学校横断歩道を示しています。減速し、子供に注意してください。

ja.question: この黄色い丸い標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: この先、ラウンドアバウト（環状交差点）
choices.B: 病院ゾーン
choices.C: この先、踏切
choices.D: 追い越し禁止区間

ja.explanation: 黒いXと2つのRが描かれた黄色い丸い標識は、この先に踏切があることを示す事前警告標識です。減速し、列車が来ないか見て、音を聞いて確認してください。

ja.question: この標識は通常どこで見かけますか？

choices.A: 学校横断歩道
choices.B: 踏切
choices.C: 病院の入り口
choices.D: 歩道橋

ja.explanation: 白いX型の踏切標識（クロスバック）は踏切に設置されています。これは列車に道を譲らなければならないことを意味します。列車が接近している場合は、停止しなければなりません。

ja.question: この黄色いひし形の標識は何を示していますか？

choices.A: この先、行き止まり
choices.B: 右折必須
choices.C: この先、右カーブ
choices.D: この先、迂回路

ja.explanation: 曲がった矢印が描かれた黄色いひし形の標識は、この先にカーブがあることを警告しています。カーブに入る前に減速してください。

ja.question: この標識はカーブ標識とどう違いますか？

choices.A: より緩やかな曲がり角を示している
choices.B: より大幅な減速を必要とする急な曲がり角を警告している
choices.C: 右折専用を意味している
choices.D: 高速道路でのみ使用される

ja.explanation: 急カーブ標識（より角度のついた矢印）は、通常のカーブ標識よりも急な曲がり角を示しています。この曲がり角の手前では、より大幅に減速する必要があります。

ja.question: この標識はどのような道路状況を警告していますか？

choices.A: 曲がりくねった道路
choices.B: 前方に単一のカーブ
choices.C: 反対方向に向かう2つの連続するカーブ
choices.D: 前方にラウンドアバウト（環状交差点）

ja.explanation: リバースカーブ（S字カーブ）標識は、前方に反対方向に向かう2つのカーブがあることを警告しています。減速し、道路が最初に一方へ、次に他方へ曲がることに備えてください。

ja.question: この標識は何を予測するよう警告していますか？

choices.A: 単一の急カーブ
choices.B: 滑りやすい路面
choices.C: 前方に連続するカーブや曲がり角
choices.D: 前方に坂道

ja.explanation: つづら折り（連続カーブ）標識は、前方に連続するカーブや曲がり角があることを警告しています。減速し、変化する道路状況に注意してください。

ja.question: この標識は何に備えるよう指示していますか？

choices.A: 車線の減少
choices.B: 別の道路からの合流車両
choices.C: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路の始まり
choices.D: 1車線に狭まる道路

ja.explanation: 黄色いひし形の合流標識は、別の道路からの車両があなたの車線に合流してくることを警告しています。速度と位置を調整する準備をしてください。

ja.question: この標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: 前方に橋
choices.B: 前方の道路幅減少
choices.C: 車線の終了
choices.D: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路の終了

ja.explanation: この警戒標識は、前方の道路が狭くなることを示しています。道路幅の減少に備え、車線内の位置を調整してください。

ja.question: この標識は前方に何があることを示していますか？

choices.A: 道路の行き止まり
choices.B: 対面通行
choices.C: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路の始まり
choices.D: 高速道路の出口

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方の道路が中央分離帯や防護柵で対向車線と区切られた幹線道路になることを警告しています。右側を通行してください。

ja.question: この標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路の始まり
choices.B: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路が終わり、対面通行に戻る
choices.C: 前方に合流エリア
choices.D: 前方で道路工事

ja.explanation: この標識は、中央分離帯のある幹線道路が終了することを警告しています。対向車線との間の中央分離帯がなくなります。対面通行に備えてください。

ja.question: この標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: 中央分離帯のある幹線道路の始まり
choices.B: 前方に追い越し可能区間
choices.C: 前方は対面通行 — 車両が双方向に通行する
choices.D: 前方で車線のシフト（移動）

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方が対面通行であることを警告しています。一方通行の道路や中央分離帯のある幹線道路を離れ、反対方向に進む車両とすれ違うことになります。

ja.question: この標識はどのような道路状況を警告していますか？

choices.A: 凍結した道路状況
choices.B: 濡れると滑りやすくなる道路
choices.C: 前方に曲がりくねった道路
choices.D: 凹凸のある路面

ja.explanation: 「濡れると滑りやすい（スリップ注意）」の標識は、雨天時や路面が濡れている状態では非常に滑りやすくなることを警告しています。減速し、急ブレーキや急ハンドルを避けてください。

ja.question: この標識は何を警告していますか？

choices.A: 道路の段差
choices.B: 凹凸のある路面
choices.C: 前方に急な坂道や勾配
choices.D: 道路工事

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方に急な坂道や勾配があることを警告しています。特にトラックを運転している場合や牽引している場合は、速度を調整し、低速ギアにシフトダウンする必要があるかもしれません。

ja.question: この標識は、何に備えるよう警告していますか？

choices.A: 前方に一時停止標識がある
choices.B: 前方に信号機がある
choices.C: 学校の横断歩道がある
choices.D: 警察の検問所がある

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方に信号機があることを警告しています。信号が赤または黄色の場合は停止する準備をしてください。この標識は、遠くから信号機が見えにくい場所によく設置されます。

ja.question: この標識は、前方に何があることを示していますか？

choices.A: 「ゆずりあい（Yield）」の標識
choices.B: 信号機
choices.C: 必ず停止しなければならない一時停止標識
choices.D: スピードハンプ（減速帯）

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方に一時停止標識があることを警告しています。減速を始め、一時停止標識で完全に停止する準備をしてください。

ja.question: この標識は何について警告していますか？

choices.A: 前方に踏切がある
choices.B: 前方に十字路または交差点がある
choices.C: 前方に病院がある
choices.D: 横断歩道がある

ja.explanation: この標識は、前方に十字路または四差路の交差点があることを警告しています。脇道から進入してくる車両に注意してください。

ja.question: この標識は何について警告していますか？

choices.A: 前方に丁字路（T字路）がある
choices.B: 右側から合流する脇道がある
choices.C: 道路にカーブがある
choices.D: 行き止まりである

ja.explanation: この標識は、右側から合流する脇道があることを警告しています。脇道から幹線道路に進入してくる車両に注意してください。

ja.question: この標識はどういう意味ですか？

choices.A: 車線が合流している
choices.B: 車線が減少している
choices.C: 新しい車線が追加されている（合流の必要なし）
choices.D: 右折が必須である

ja.explanation: 車線追加の標識は、合流を必要とせずに新しい車線が幹線道路に加わることを意味します。ランプ（進入路）から進入する車両には、専用の新しい車線があります。

ja.question: この標識は何を禁止していますか？

choices.A: 常時停車すること
choices.B: このエリアに駐車すること
choices.C: 停車またはアイドリングすること
choices.D: 荷物の積み下ろしをすること

ja.explanation: 赤と白の「駐車禁止（NO PARKING）」の標識は、このエリアに車両を駐車できないことを意味します。乗客の乗り降りのために短時間停車することは許可されています。

ja.question: この標識があるスペースには、誰が駐車できますか？

choices.A: 15分未満であれば誰でも
choices.B: 高齢者のみ
choices.C: 有効な障害者用プラカードまたはナンバープレートを掲示している車両のみ
choices.D: 障害のある同乗者がいるすべての運転手

ja.explanation: 車椅子のマークが描かれた青い標識は、障害者専用の駐車スペースであることを示しています。有効な障害者用駐車プラカードまたはナンバープレートを掲示している車両のみが、これらのスペースに駐車できます。違反した場合は高額な罰金が科せられます。

en.question: What rights and responsibilities do motorcyclists have on the roadway?

choices.A: Fewer rights than passenger vehicles.
choices.B: The same rights and responsibilities as drivers of other vehicles.
choices.C: Only the right to ride in designated motorcycle lanes.
choices.D: Special privileges that exempt them from traffic signals.

en.explanation: According to the manual, the motorcyclist has the same rights and responsibilities on the roadway as drivers of other vehicles.

en.question: According to the manual, who causes almost two-thirds of crashes involving a motorcycle and another type of vehicle?

choices.A: The motorcyclist.
choices.B: The driver of the other vehicle.
choices.C: Pedestrians crossing the street.
choices.D: Unpredictable weather conditions.

en.explanation: The manual states that almost two-thirds of these crashes are caused not by the motorcyclist but by the driver of the other vehicle.

en.question: How much following distance should you leave when following a motorcycle?

choices.A: One to two seconds.
choices.B: Three or four seconds.
choices.C: Five to six seconds.
choices.D: At least ten seconds.

en.explanation: The manual instructs drivers to leave three or four seconds when following a motorcycle, so the motorcyclist has enough time to maneuver or stop in an emergency.

en.question: Why is it important to leave extra following distance behind a motorcycle in dry conditions?

choices.A: Motorcycles take longer to stop than cars.
choices.B: Motorcycles can stop more quickly than a vehicle.
choices.C: Motorcycles frequently stall in dry weather.
choices.D: The rider's vision is impaired by dry dust.

en.explanation: The manual notes that in dry conditions, motorcycles can stop more quickly than a vehicle, requiring a greater following distance to avoid rear-end collisions.

en.question: What should you do if you see a flashing turn signal on an approaching motorcycle?

choices.A: Proceed immediately because the motorcycle is definitely turning.
choices.B: Honk your horn to remind the rider to turn.
choices.C: Wait to be sure the motorcycle is going to turn before you proceed.
choices.D: Turn on your high beams to increase visibility.

en.explanation: Motorcycle signals usually are not self-canceling and riders sometimes forget to turn them off. The manual advises to wait to be sure the motorcycle is going to turn before you proceed.

en.question: When driving in the same lane as a motorcycle, you should:

choices.A: Share the lane to allow more vehicles to pass.
choices.B: Drive closely beside the motorcycle to protect it from wind.
choices.C: Allow the motorcyclist a full lane width and not share the lane.
choices.D: Pass the motorcycle within the same lane if there is enough room.

en.explanation: The manual states to allow a motorcyclist a full lane width and explicitly says, "Do not share the lane."

en.question: A significant percentage of motorcycle crashes involving another vehicle are caused by:

choices.A: The other vehicle turning left in front of the motorcyclist.
choices.B: The motorcycle rear-ending the other vehicle.
choices.C: The other vehicle turning right on a red light.
choices.D: The motorcycle passing on the right shoulder.

en.explanation: The manual states that nearly 40 percent of motorcycle crashes involving another motor vehicle were caused by the other vehicle turning left in front of the motorcyclist.

en.question: How might a motorcyclist react to hazardous road conditions such as potholes or railroad crossings?

choices.A: By maintaining a constant speed and straight line.
choices.B: By suddenly changing speed or adjusting their position within the lane.
choices.C: By stopping completely in the middle of the road.
choices.D: By signaling for a turn and exiting the roadway.

en.explanation: Motorcyclists may change speed or adjust their position within a lane suddenly in reaction to road and traffic conditions such as potholes, gravel, and railroad crossings.

en.question: What effect can strong winds or wind gusts from large trucks have on a motorcycle?

choices.A: They improve the motorcycle's fuel efficiency.
choices.B: They can move a motorcycle across an entire lane.
choices.C: They force the motorcycle to speed up.
choices.D: They have no significant effect on a motorcycle's path.

en.explanation: The manual warns that a strong gust of wind can move a motorcycle across an entire lane if the rider is not prepared for it.

en.question: According to Pennsylvania law, the rules of the road apply to which three types of vehicles?

choices.A: Motor vehicles, boats, and airplanes.
choices.B: Bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, and motor vehicles.
choices.C: Motor vehicles, ATVs, and snowmobiles.
choices.D: Passenger cars, commercial trucks, and motorcycles only.

en.explanation: The manual states that the rules of the road apply to three types of vehicles recognized by Pennsylvania law: bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, and motor vehicles.

en.question: How do traffic lights apply to bicyclists in Pennsylvania?

choices.A: Bicyclists may treat red lights as yield signs.
choices.B: Bicyclists are exempt from stopping at red lights.
choices.C: Bicyclists, just like motorists, are required to stop at red lights.
choices.D: Bicyclists must dismount and walk their bikes through all intersections.

en.explanation: The manual explicitly states, "For example, all bicyclists, just like motorists, are required to stop at red lights."

en.question: Which of the following statements about driving in Pennsylvania is true?

choices.A: Driving is a constitutional right for all citizens.
choices.B: Driving is a privilege and not a right.
choices.C: Driving is a right only for those over the age of 18.
choices.D: Driving is a right that cannot be revoked.

en.explanation: The manual clearly states in the introduction that "Driving is a privilege and not a right."

en.question: What additional form must be completed before taking the Knowledge Test if you are under the age of 18?

choices.A: The Commercial Driver's License Application.
choices.B: The Vehicle Registration Form.
choices.C: The Parent or Guardian Consent Form (DL-180TD).
choices.D: The Organ Donor Designation Form.

en.explanation: The manual states that if you are under the age of 18, your parent or guardian must complete the Parent or Guardian Consent Form (DL-180TD).

en.question: According to the manual, what is a very important responsibility regarding alcohol and driving?

choices.A: You should only drink if you are driving a short distance.
choices.B: You must never mix drinking and driving.
choices.C: You may drink and drive if you stay under the speed limit.
choices.D: You can drink and drive as long as you have a licensed passenger.

en.explanation: The manual emphasizes that "One very important responsibility is that you never mix drinking and driving."

en.question: Why can it be difficult to judge the speed and distance of an approaching motorcycle?

choices.A: Motorcycles typically travel much faster than the speed limit.
choices.B: Motorcycles have a much smaller profile than other vehicles.
choices.C: Motorcycles do not have headlights.
choices.D: Motorcycles blend in with the color of the pavement.

en.explanation: The manual explains that motorcycles have a much smaller profile than other vehicles, which can make it more difficult to judge the speed and distance of an approaching motorcycle.

en.question: How old must you be to apply for a non-commercial learner's permit in Pennsylvania?

choices.A: 15 years old
choices.B: 15 and a half years old
choices.C: 16 years old
choices.D: 18 years old

en.explanation: According to the manual, you cannot apply for your permit before your 16th birthday.

en.question: How early can your health care provider complete the physical examination for your learner's permit application?

choices.A: No earlier than 3 months prior to your 16th birthday
choices.B: No earlier than 6 months prior to your 16th birthday
choices.C: No earlier than 1 year prior to your 16th birthday
choices.D: Only on or after your 16th birthday

en.explanation: The physical examination date may not be more than six (6) months prior to your 16th birthday.

en.question: Which three tests must you pass to obtain your driver's license?

choices.A: Vision, Knowledge, and Road Tests
choices.B: Hearing, Knowledge, and Road Tests
choices.C: Vision, Reflex, and Road Tests
choices.D: Knowledge, Road, and Highway Tests

en.explanation: You will need to take and pass the Vision, Knowledge and Road Tests to get your driver's license.

en.question: If you are under 18 and your parent or guardian cannot accompany you to the Driver License Center, what must be done with the Consent Form (DL-180TD)?

choices.A: It must be signed by a school principal.
choices.B: It must be mailed directly to PennDOT.
choices.C: It must be signed in the presence of a notary.
choices.D: It must be signed by a licensed driver over 21.

en.explanation: If the parent or guardian cannot accompany the applicant, the DL-180TD must be signed in the presence of a notary.

en.question: If you are over 18 years of age applying for a permit, how many proofs of residency must you present?

choices.A: One
choices.B: Two
choices.C: Three
choices.D: Four

en.explanation: If you are over 18 years of age, you must present two (2) proofs of residency.

en.question: When bringing proof of date of birth and identification to the Driver License Center, which of the following is true?

choices.A: High-quality photocopies are preferred.
choices.B: Digital copies on a smartphone are acceptable.
choices.C: Documents must be originals and photocopies will not be accepted.
choices.D: A school ID can replace a birth certificate.

en.explanation: The manual states that proof of date of birth and identification documents must be originals (photocopies will not be accepted).

en.question: Once issued, how long is a Pennsylvania non-commercial learner's permit valid?

choices.A: 6 months
choices.B: 1 year
choices.C: 2 years
choices.D: 4 years

en.explanation: After passing the Knowledge Test, the examiner will give you a learner's permit, which is valid for one (1) year.

en.question: If you are under 18, how many hours of behind-the-wheel skill-building must you complete before taking your Road Test?

choices.A: 40 hours
choices.B: 50 hours
choices.C: 65 hours
choices.D: 100 hours

en.explanation: If you are under the age of 18, you are required to complete at least 65 hours of behind-the-wheel skill-building before taking your Road Test.

en.question: For drivers under 18, the mandatory behind-the-wheel skill-building must include specific hours for certain conditions. What are they?

choices.A: 10 hours of nighttime driving and 5 hours of bad weather driving
choices.B: 5 hours of nighttime driving and 10 hours of bad weather driving
choices.C: 15 hours of nighttime driving and 5 hours of highway driving
choices.D: 10 hours of highway driving and 10 hours of bad weather driving

en.explanation: The 65 hours of skill-building must include no less than 10 hours of nighttime driving and five (5) hours of bad weather driving.

en.question: Who is permitted to ride in the front seat with a driver who holds a learner's permit?

choices.A: Any licensed driver who is at least 18 years old.
choices.B: A licensed driver who is at least 21, or a licensed parent/guardian/spouse who is 18 or older.
choices.C: Any passenger over the age of 21, regardless of license status.
choices.D: A licensed driving instructor only.

en.explanation: A licensed driver who is at least 21 years of age or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older and holds a driver's license must ride with you in the front seat.

en.question: What is the passenger limit for drivers under the age of 18?

choices.A: Only one non-family member is allowed.
choices.B: No passengers are allowed other than the supervising driver.
choices.C: They cannot have more passengers in the vehicle than the number of seat belts.
choices.D: Up to three passengers under the age of 18.

en.explanation: Drivers under the age of 18 cannot have more passengers in the vehicle than the number of seat belts.

en.question: How long is the mandatory waiting period from the permit issue date before a driver under 18 can take the Road Test?

choices.A: 30 days
choices.B: 3 months
choices.C: 6 months
choices.D: 1 year

en.explanation: You must wait the mandatory six (6) months from your permit issue date before you may take your Road Test.

en.question: What happens if you do not pass your road test after three (3) tries?

choices.A: You must wait one year before testing again.
choices.B: You may obtain a DL-31 form to Add/Extend/Replace/Change/Correct your permit.
choices.C: Your learner's permit is permanently revoked.
choices.D: You must retake the Knowledge Test immediately.

en.explanation: If your learner's permit expires or if you do not pass your road test after three (3) tries, you may obtain a Non-Commercial Learner's Permit Application to Add/Extend/Replace/Change/Correct (DL-31).

en.question: If you fail the Knowledge Test, how soon can you take it again?

choices.A: You can take it a second time on the same day if you go to a different location.
choices.B: You must wait at least 7 days.
choices.C: You may take the Knowledge Test only one time on any day.
choices.D: You must wait 30 days before retaking the test.

en.explanation: You may take the Knowledge Test only one time on any day regardless of test location.

en.question: If you plan to use your Pennsylvania learner's permit to drive in another state, what should you do?

choices.A: Assume it is valid nationwide.
choices.B: Apply for an international driving permit.
choices.C: Check with your insurance company and the other state's Department of Transportation.
choices.D: Only drive during daylight hours in the other state.

en.explanation: If you are using your learner's permit for driving outside PA, check with your insurance company and the other state's Department of Transportation to make sure your permit is considered valid.

en.question: How many times per day are you permitted to take the Knowledge Test?

choices.A: As many times as needed until you pass
choices.B: Two times
choices.C: One time
choices.D: Three times

en.explanation: According to the manual, you may take the Knowledge Test only one time on any day regardless of test location.

en.question: If you are under 18 years of age, what is required to obtain an 'ORGAN DONOR' designation on your driver's license?

choices.A: A medical examination certificate
choices.B: Written consent from a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 or older
choices.C: A mandatory $10 donation to the Organ Donation Awareness Trust Fund
choices.D: A notarized affidavit from your primary care physician

en.explanation: Applicants under 18 years of age may request the organ donor designation, but they must have written consent from a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older.

en.question: Will your Social Security number be printed on your learner's permit or driver's license?

choices.A: Yes, it is printed on all permits and licenses for identification.
choices.B: Yes, but only on the learner's permit.
choices.C: No, it will not be printed on your learner's permit or driver's license.
choices.D: Yes, unless you specifically request to have it removed.

en.explanation: The manual states: 'Your Social Security number will not be printed on your learner’s permit or driver’s license.'

en.question: What happens if your vision fails to meet the Pennsylvania vision standards during testing?

choices.A: You are permanently disqualified from obtaining a driver's license.
choices.B: You will be given a Report of Eye Examination Form (DL-102) to be completed by an eye doctor or physician.
choices.C: You must immediately take a specialized road test.
choices.D: You will automatically receive a daylight-only driving restriction without further testing.

en.explanation: If your vision fails to meet the standards, the examiner will give you a Report of Eye Examination Form (DL-102) to be completed by an optometrist, ophthalmologist, or family physician.

en.question: If you move to Pennsylvania and hold a valid driver's license from another state, how long do you have to get a Pennsylvania driver's license?

choices.A: 30 days
choices.B: 60 days
choices.C: 90 days
choices.D: 6 months

en.explanation: People who just moved into Pennsylvania holding a valid driver's license from another state or Canada must get a Pennsylvania driver's license within 60 days after moving.

en.question: How long are individuals with a valid foreign driver's license authorized to drive in Pennsylvania?

choices.A: Up to 30 days from their date of entry into the United States
choices.B: Up to 6 months from their date of entry into the United States
choices.C: Up to one year from their date of entry into the United States, or upon expiration of their foreign license, whichever comes first
choices.D: Indefinitely, as long as they carry an International Driving Permit

en.explanation: Individuals who possess a valid foreign driver's license are authorized to drive in Pennsylvania for up to one year from their date of entry into the United States, or upon expiration of their foreign license, whichever comes first.

en.question: Who is authorized to supervise a driver under 18 years of age who holds a Junior Learner's Permit?

choices.A: Any licensed driver who is at least 18 years old
choices.B: A licensed driver who is at least 21 years old, or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 or older
choices.C: Any licensed driver with at least one year of driving experience
choices.D: Only a state-certified driving instructor

en.explanation: You may only drive under the supervision of a licensed driver who is at least 21 years of age or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older and holds a driver's license.

en.question: When driving with a Junior Learner's Permit or Junior Driver's License, what is the rule regarding the number of passengers?

choices.A: You may not carry any passengers other than your supervising driver.
choices.B: You may carry up to 5 passengers regardless of the number of seat belts.
choices.C: You may not carry more passengers than seat belts available in the vehicle you are driving.
choices.D: You may only carry immediate family members.

en.explanation: For both the Junior Learner's Permit and Junior Driver's License, the manual states: 'You may not carry more passengers than seat belts available in the vehicle you are driving.'

en.question: What are the restricted driving hours for a Junior Driver's License unless accompanied by a parent, guardian, or spouse who is 18 or older?

choices.A: 9 p.m. to 6 a.m.
choices.B: 10 p.m. to 5 a.m.
choices.C: 11 p.m. to 5 a.m.
choices.D: Midnight to 6 a.m.

en.explanation: With a junior driver's license, you may not drive between the hours of 11 p.m. and 5 a.m., unless your parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older is with you.

en.question: Which of the following allows a junior driver to legally drive between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. without a parent or guardian present?

choices.A: Returning home from a school sporting event
choices.B: Being involved in public or charitable service, a volunteer fire company, or employment
choices.C: Driving to a friend's house for a study group
choices.D: Having a clean driving record for at least 3 months

en.explanation: You may drive between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. if you are involved in public or charitable service, a member of a volunteer fire company or employed during those hours, provided you carry a notarized affidavit.

en.question: During the first six months of driving on a Junior Driver's License, how many passengers under age 18 (who are not immediate family members) may you carry without a parent or guardian present?

choices.A: None
choices.B: One
choices.C: Two
choices.D: Three

en.explanation: You may not carry more than one (1) passenger under the age of 18 who is not an immediate family member unless a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older is in the vehicle with you.

en.question: A junior driver will receive a mandatory 90-day suspension if they are convicted of driving how many miles per hour over the posted speed limit?

choices.A: 10 mph or more
choices.B: 15 mph or more
choices.C: 20 mph or more
choices.D: 26 mph or more

en.explanation: You will receive a mandatory 90-day suspension if you accumulate six (6) or more points or are convicted of driving 26 miles per hour (mph) or more over the posted speed limit.

en.question: At what age does a Junior Driver's License automatically become a regular driver's license?

choices.A: 17 years of age
choices.B: 18 years of age
choices.C: 19 years of age
choices.D: 21 years of age

en.explanation: The manual states: 'Your junior driver’s license will automatically become a regular driver’s license when you turn 18 years of age.'

en.question: Which class of Pennsylvania driver's license covers regular passenger vehicles, pick-up trucks, and vans?

choices.A: Class A
choices.B: Class B
choices.C: Class C
choices.D: Class M

en.explanation: The manual is designed to provide information for a non-commercial Class C driver's license, which is the class that covers regular passenger vehicles, pick-up trucks, or vans.

en.question: What is the minimum age required to obtain a Class A driver's license in Pennsylvania?
en.explanation: Under 'CLASSES OF DRIVER’S LICENSES', the manual lists 'CLASS A (minimum age 18)'.

en.question: Under what condition can a Class C license holder operate a fire or emergency vehicle?

choices.A: If they have a Class M endorsement
choices.B: If the vehicle weighs less than 26,000 pounds
choices.C: If they have a certificate of authorization from a fire chief or head of the rescue squad
choices.D: If they are at least 21 years old

en.explanation: A firefighter or rescue squad member with a Class C license can operate emergency vehicles if they have a certificate of authorization from a fire chief or head of the rescue or emergency squad.

en.question: What does an '8' restriction on a Class M driver's license indicate?

choices.A: The driver must wear corrective lenses
choices.B: The driver is prohibited from operating a two-wheeled motorcycle
choices.C: The driver is prohibited from operating a motorcycle and may only operate a motor-driven cycle
choices.D: The driver can only operate a motorcycle during daylight hours

en.explanation: If you test on a motor-driven cycle, an '8' restriction will appear on your license, which prohibits you from operating a motorcycle.

en.question: How many questions must you answer correctly to pass the Knowledge Test?

choices.A: 12 out of 15
choices.B: 15 out of 18
choices.C: 16 out of 20
choices.D: 18 out of 18

en.explanation: The Knowledge Test consists of 18 multiple choice questions, and you must answer 15 questions correctly to pass the test.

en.question: If you fail the Knowledge Test, when are you permitted to retake it?

choices.A: After 7 days
choices.B: The following business day
choices.C: After 30 days
choices.D: Immediately on the same day

en.explanation: If you fail the Knowledge Test, you will be permitted to retake the test the following business day.

en.question: Who may accompany you to the Driver License Center for your Road Test if they are 18 years of age or older?

choices.A: Any licensed driver
choices.B: A friend who has had their license for one year
choices.C: A parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse with a valid driver's license
choices.D: A sibling with a learner's permit

en.explanation: You must be accompanied by a person who is at least 21 years of age, or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse who is 18 years of age or older with a valid driver's license.

en.question: Which of the following will cause you to not be allowed to take the Road Test?

choices.A: Bringing a vehicle with a manual transmission
choices.B: Failing to bring a copy of your documents instead of the originals
choices.C: A vehicle part being determined unsafe or not meeting state inspection requirements
choices.D: Having a self-parking feature installed in your vehicle

en.explanation: If it is determined any part of your vehicle is unsafe or does not meet state inspection requirements, you will not be allowed to take the Road Test.

en.question: What are the dimensions of the space you must parallel park your vehicle in during the Road Test?

choices.A: 20 feet long and 6 feet wide
choices.B: 24 feet long and 8 feet wide
choices.C: 25 feet long and 10 feet wide
choices.D: 30 feet long and 8 feet wide

en.explanation: You must park your vehicle midway between two uprights in a space that is 24 feet long and eight (8) feet wide.

en.question: How many attempts and adjustments are you allowed to successfully parallel park during the Road Test?

choices.A: Two attempts using no more than five adjustments
choices.B: One attempt using no more than three adjustments
choices.C: Three attempts using no more than three adjustments
choices.D: One attempt using no more than five adjustments

en.explanation: You have one (1) attempt to successfully park your vehicle using no more than three (3) adjustments.

en.question: What is the rule regarding vehicles equipped with Advanced Parking Guidance Systems (self-parking vehicles) during the Road Test?

choices.A: They cannot be used for the Road Test under any circumstances
choices.B: The self-parking feature can be used only for the parallel parking portion
choices.C: They can be used, but the self-parking feature must be turned off and not activated
choices.D: The examiner will activate the feature to test its functionality

en.explanation: Vehicles equipped with Advanced Parking Guidance Systems can be used for testing; however, the self-parking feature must be turned off and is not permitted to be activated during the Road Test.

en.question: If you are under the age of 18 and fail the Road Test, how long must you wait before you can retake it?

choices.A: 24 hours
choices.B: 3 days
choices.C: 7 days
choices.D: 14 days

en.explanation: If you are under the age of 18 and fail the Road Test, Pennsylvania law requires you to wait seven (7) days before you can retake the Road Test.

en.question: How many chances do you have to pass the Road Test with each learner's permit?

choices.A: One
choices.B: Two
choices.C: Three
choices.D: Unlimited before the expiration date

en.explanation: You have three (3) chances with each learner’s permit to pass the Road Test before the expiration date of the learner’s permit.

en.question: What must you do if you have not successfully completed the Road Test within three years of your physical examination date?

choices.A: Pay a late fee to extend the permit
choices.B: Start over with another Non-Commercial Learner's Permit Application and retake the Knowledge Test
choices.C: Take an approved driver's education course
choices.D: Wait six months before reapplying

en.explanation: If you have not taken or successfully completed the Road Test within three (3) years of your physical examination date, you must start over with another Non-Commercial Learner’s Permit Application (DL-180) and retake the Knowledge Test.

en.question: A Class B driver's license is required to operate which of the following?

choices.A: Any single vehicle rated in excess of 26,000 pounds
choices.B: Any combination of vehicles with a gross weight rating of 26,001 pounds or more
choices.C: A motorcycle with more than two wheels
choices.D: A motor-driven cycle with an automatic transmission

en.explanation: A Class B license is required to operate any single vehicle rated in excess of 26,000 pounds, such as motor homes rated at 26,001 pounds or more.

en.question: What will happen if you fail to properly operate any of the vehicle controls (such as wipers, parking brake, or hazard lights) prior to the Road Test?

choices.A: You will lose points but can still pass the test
choices.B: The examiner will show you how to use them and continue the test
choices.C: It will result in a failure of the Road Test
choices.D: You will be restricted to daylight driving only

en.explanation: Failure to properly operate any of the vehicle controls will result in a failure of the Road Test.

en.question: How are traffic lights arranged when they are in a horizontal line?

choices.A: Red is always on the left and green on the right
choices.B: Green is always on the left and red on the right
choices.C: Yellow is always on the left and red on the right
choices.D: Red is always on the top and green on the bottom

en.explanation: The manual states, 'When they are arranged horizontally, red is always on the left and green on the right.'

en.question: Under what condition are you permitted to make a left turn on a steady red light?

choices.A: When turning from a two-way street onto a one-way street
choices.B: When there is no oncoming traffic on any street
choices.C: When turning from a one-way street onto another one-way street
choices.D: You may never turn left on a steady red light

en.explanation: The manual states you may turn left after stopping at a red light if you are in the left lane and turning left from a one-way street onto another one-way street, unless a sign tells you not to turn.

en.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

choices.A: Slow down and proceed with caution
choices.B: It has the same meaning as a STOP sign
choices.C: The traffic light is broken and you have the right-of-way
choices.D: Stop only if there is cross traffic approaching

en.explanation: According to the manual, 'A flashing red light has the same meaning as a STOP sign. You must come to a complete stop. Then, look both ways, and proceed only after the intersection is clear.'

en.question: How should you treat an intersection with non-functioning traffic lights?

choices.A: Yield to the vehicle on your right and proceed without stopping
choices.B: Wait for a police officer to direct traffic
choices.C: Proceed through the intersection at your normal speed
choices.D: Treat it as though it were a four-way STOP sign

en.explanation: The manual explicitly states, 'A non-functioning traffic signal should be treated as though it were a four-way STOP sign.'

en.question: What does a steady yellow 'X' over a traffic lane indicate?

choices.A: You are not allowed to use the traffic lane at all
choices.B: You must change lanes because the direction of travel for that lane is about to be reversed
choices.C: You may use the lane but must slow down for a toll booth
choices.D: You may only turn left from that specific lane

en.explanation: The manual explains that a steady yellow 'X' over a traffic lane means 'you must change lanes because the direction of travel for that lane is about to be reversed. Get ready to leave the lane safely.'

en.question: What should a pedestrian do if the flashing DON'T WALK or flashing upraised hand begins while they are already in the street?

choices.A: Stop immediately and wait in the middle of the street
choices.B: Turn around and go back to the starting curb
choices.C: Finish crossing the street
choices.D: Run as fast as possible to the nearest curb

en.explanation: The manual instructs pedestrians that when the flashing DON'T WALK or flashing upraised hand begins, they should 'Finish crossing, if you are in the street.'

en.question: What must you do when driving near a blind pedestrian carrying a white cane or walking with a guide dog?

choices.A: Honk your horn to let them know you are approaching
choices.B: Maintain your speed but steer carefully around them
choices.C: Stop and verbally tell them it is safe to cross
choices.D: Slow down, always yield the right-of-way, and proceed with caution

en.explanation: The manual states: 'When driving near a blind pedestrian who is carrying a white cane or walking with a guide dog, you must slow down, always yield the right-of-way and then proceed with caution.'

en.question: What is the maximum speed limit in a school zone when the yellow signals are flashing?

choices.A: 15 mph
choices.B: 20 mph
choices.C: 25 mph
choices.D: 35 mph

en.explanation: The manual states, 'You must travel no faster than 15 mph when the yellow signals are flashing or during the time periods indicated on the sign.'

en.question: What is the penalty for exceeding the speed limit in a school zone?

choices.A: A warning for the first offense
choices.B: One point on your driving record and a fine
choices.C: Three points on your driving record and a fine
choices.D: Immediate license suspension for 30 days

en.explanation: According to the manual, 'Exceeding the speed limit in a school zone will result in three (3) points on your driving record, and you will also be fined.'

en.question: What should you do if you are approaching a railroad crossing and the crossing gate is lowered?

choices.A: Slow down and drive around the gate if no train is visible
choices.B: Stop and wait until the gate is raised and all signals are completed
choices.C: Stop, look both ways, and proceed around the gate carefully
choices.D: Honk your horn and proceed without stopping

en.explanation: The manual states you are required to stop at lowered crossing gates and warns: 'Do not move forward or attempt to go around any gate or ignore any signal of an approaching train. Proceed with caution only after all signals are completed...'

en.question: What does a steady green arrow mean?

choices.A: You may turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic
choices.B: You must stop before turning in the direction of the arrow
choices.C: The lane you are in is about to close
choices.D: You may turn the way the arrow points, and your turn is protected

en.explanation: The manual states, 'A STEADY GREEN ARROW means you may turn the way the arrow points. When you turn during the green arrow phase, your turn is "protected" because oncoming traffic is stopped by a red light.'

en.question: What does a flashing yellow arrow indicate?

choices.A: You have a protected turn in the direction of the arrow
choices.B: You must come to a complete stop before turning
choices.C: You may turn with caution, but must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians
choices.D: The traffic light is broken and you should treat it as a stop sign

en.explanation: The manual states, 'A FLASHING YELLOW ARROW means you may turn in the direction of the arrow with caution, however, you must first yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians. When you turn during the flashing yellow arrow phase, your turn is NOT protected...'

en.question: How many cars may enter the highway each time the ramp-metering light turns green on a single-lane ramp?

choices.A: One car
choices.B: Two cars
choices.C: Three cars
choices.D: As many cars as can safely pass before it turns red

en.explanation: The manual specifies regarding ramp-metering signals: 'On single-lane ramps, only one (1) car may enter the highway each time the light turns green.'

en.question: What should you do if traffic is backed up and you need to cross a railroad track?

choices.A: Stop on the tracks and wait for traffic to move
choices.B: Stop your vehicle in a location entirely clear of the railroad tracks
choices.C: Proceed slowly over the tracks, keeping as close to the car ahead as possible
choices.D: Honk your horn to make the cars ahead move faster

en.explanation: The manual states, 'If traffic is backed up because of a traffic signal, stop sign or for any other reason, make sure you stop your vehicle in a location where it will be entirely clear of any railroad tracks.'

en.question: What are the three basic categories of traffic signs?

choices.A: Regulatory, Warning, and Guide signs.
choices.B: Informational, Directional, and Warning signs.
choices.C: Speed, Stop, and Yield signs.
choices.D: Mandatory, Advisory, and Construction signs.

en.explanation: The manual states that signs are divided into three basic categories: Regulatory, Warning and Guide signs.

en.question: What is a possible consequence of disobeying the messages on regulatory signs?

choices.A: You will be required to retake your driving test.
choices.B: You could be fined and receive points on your driving record.
choices.C: Your vehicle will be immediately impounded.
choices.D: You will receive a warning for the first three offenses.

en.explanation: If you do not obey the messages on regulatory signs, you could be fined and receive points on your driving record because you are breaking the law.

en.question: When approaching a STOP sign with a painted crosswalk or stop line, where must you stop your vehicle?

choices.A: Just past the first painted line.
choices.B: Before the front of your vehicle reaches the first painted line.
choices.C: In the middle of the crosswalk to see better.
choices.D: Parallel to the STOP sign itself.

en.explanation: When you see a crosswalk or a stop line (white top bar), you must stop before the front of your vehicle reaches the first painted line.

en.question: If two vehicles reach a FOUR-WAY STOP intersection at the same time, who must yield the right-of-way?

choices.A: The driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.
choices.B: The driver on the right yields to the driver on the left.
choices.C: The vehicle traveling at a faster speed yields.
choices.D: The vehicle that flashes its headlights first has the right-of-way.

en.explanation: At a FOUR-WAY STOP, if two vehicles reach the intersection at the same time, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.

en.question: What is the shape of a YIELD sign?

choices.A: Octagon (8-sided)
choices.B: Pennant
choices.C: Triangle (3-sided)
choices.D: Vertical rectangle

en.explanation: The manual explicitly states that YIELD signs are triangular (3-sided) in shape.

en.question: How should a driver treat a RAILROAD CROSSBUCK sign?

choices.A: As a mandatory STOP sign.
choices.B: As a YIELD sign.
choices.C: As a DO NOT ENTER sign.
choices.D: As a SPEED LIMIT sign.

en.explanation: You should treat the crossbuck sign as a YIELD sign; slow down and prepare to stop, if you see or hear a train approaching.

en.question: When turning onto a divided highway at an intersection, what turns are permitted at the first and second roadways?

choices.A: Left turn only at the first roadway, right turn only at the second.
choices.B: Right turn only at the first roadway, left turn only at the second.
choices.C: Right turns are permitted at both roadways.
choices.D: Left turns are permitted at both roadways.

en.explanation: At a divided highway, the manual states: 'At the first roadway, you can only turn right, and at the second roadway, you can only turn left.'

en.question: What is the purpose of a CENTER LANE LEFT TURN ONLY sign?

choices.A: To provide a lane for passing slow-moving vehicles.
choices.B: To reserve a lane exclusively for left-turning vehicles in either direction.
choices.C: To indicate a lane where through traffic has the right-of-way.
choices.D: To designate a lane for emergency vehicles only.

en.explanation: This sign indicates where a lane is reserved for the exclusive use of left-turning vehicles in either direction and is not to be used for through traffic or passing.

en.question: What does a SPEED LIMIT sign indicate?

choices.A: The minimum speed you must travel under all conditions.
choices.B: The recommended speed for poor weather conditions.
choices.C: The maximum legal speed under ideal conditions.
choices.D: The speed at which you should drive during heavy traffic.

en.explanation: A SPEED LIMIT sign indicates the maximum legal speed under ideal conditions for the stretch of highway where it is posted.

en.question: According to the manual, what is the number one reason 16- and 17-year-old drivers are involved in crashes?

choices.A: Driving under the influence of alcohol.
choices.B: Texting while driving.
choices.C: Failing to yield the right-of-way.
choices.D: Driving too fast for conditions.

en.explanation: The Teen Crash Fact section states: 'Driving too fast for conditions' is the No. 1 reason 16 and 17-year-old drivers are involved in crashes.

en.question: If you accidentally find yourself in a lane controlled by a sign with a turn arrow and the word 'ONLY,' what must you do?

choices.A: Stop and wait for traffic to clear before changing lanes.
choices.B: Make the turn indicated by the arrow.
choices.C: Proceed straight through the intersection cautiously.
choices.D: Put your vehicle in reverse and back out of the lane.

en.explanation: If you are in a lane controlled by a sign with a turn arrow and the word 'ONLY,' when you reach the intersection, you must make the turn, even if you are in the turn-only lane in error.

en.question: What does a LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN sign mean?

choices.A: Left turns are protected and oncoming traffic must stop.
choices.B: Left turns are prohibited when the light is green.
choices.C: A left turn is permitted, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
choices.D: You must wait for a green arrow to make a left turn.

en.explanation: The LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN sign indicates a left turn is permitted, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.

en.question: What is the penalty for unauthorized vehicles parking in spaces reserved for disabled persons or severely disabled veterans?

choices.A: A warning sticker placed on the windshield.
choices.B: A fine and towing costs.
choices.C: Immediate suspension of the driver's license.
choices.D: Points added to the driving record.

en.explanation: Unauthorized vehicles parked in these reserved spaces are subject to a fine and towing costs.

en.question: What does the sign 'OPPOSING TRAFFIC HAS EXTENDED GREEN' indicate?

choices.A: You have the right-of-way to turn left.
choices.B: Opposing traffic must yield to you.
choices.C: Opposing traffic may continue to move after your signal has turned red.
choices.D: The traffic signal is broken and you should treat it as a four-way stop.

en.explanation: This sign is posted where opposing traffic may continue to move after your signal has turned red.

en.question: Which warning sign is the only one that is pennant-shaped?

choices.A: Stop Sign Ahead
choices.B: Yield
choices.C: No Passing Zone
choices.D: Narrow Bridge

en.explanation: The manual states that the No Passing Zone sign is the only pennant-shaped warning sign, and it is placed on the left side of the road facing the driver.

en.question: What does a 'Left Turn Yield on Flashing Yellow Arrow' sign indicate?

choices.A: Left turns are protected and oncoming traffic must stop.
choices.B: A left turn is permitted, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
choices.C: Left turns are strictly prohibited at this intersection.
choices.D: You must come to a complete stop before making a right turn.

en.explanation: This sign indicates a left turn is permitted when the yellow arrow is flashing, but you must yield to oncoming traffic because the turn is not protected.

en.question: A 'Winding Road' sign indicates that there are how many curves in a row on the road ahead?

choices.A: Exactly two curves
choices.B: Three or more curves
choices.C: One sharp curve followed by a straightaway
choices.D: Four or more sharp turns

en.explanation: The Winding Road (Series of Curves) sign indicates there are three (3) or more curves in a row on the road ahead.

en.question: What does an 'Added Lane' sign mean for drivers entering a roadway?

choices.A: Merging is not necessary because entering traffic uses a new lane.
choices.B: Entering traffic must yield to traffic already on the major roadway.
choices.C: The lane ahead will end and drivers must merge left.
choices.D: Traffic is exiting and crossing your path.

en.explanation: The Added Lane sign means merging is not necessary because the entering traffic uses a new lane that has been added to the roadway.

en.question: Where is a 'Two Direction Large Arrow' sign typically placed?

choices.A: At the beginning of a divided highway
choices.B: Before a narrow bridge or underpass
choices.C: At the far side of a T-intersection
choices.D: On the left side of a no passing zone

en.explanation: The Two Direction Large Arrow sign is placed at the far side of a T-intersection to tell you that you can only go left or right.

en.question: What should you do when driving in wet weather in an area marked with a 'Slippery When Wet' sign?

choices.A: Accelerate quickly to pass the slippery area.
choices.B: Brake sharply before making any turns.
choices.C: Reduce your speed and increase your following distance.
choices.D: Maintain your normal speed but stay in the center lane.

en.explanation: In wet weather, you should reduce your speed and increase your following distance. You should not accelerate or brake quickly.

en.question: If your vehicle strays off the roadway and one wheel drops onto a low or soft shoulder, what should you NOT do?

choices.A: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
choices.B: Slam on the brakes or steer sharply to get back on the road.
choices.C: Keep a firm grip on the steering wheel.
choices.D: Gradually slow down before attempting to return to the road.

en.explanation: The manual warns that if one wheel drops off onto a low or soft shoulder, you should not slam on the brakes or steer sharply to try to get back onto the roadway, as you can easily lose control of your vehicle.

en.question: When approaching a steep hill or downgrade, what action should you be ready to take?

choices.A: Shift to a higher gear to increase momentum.
choices.B: Shift to a lower gear to control your speed and save your brakes.
choices.C: Ride your brakes all the way down the hill.
choices.D: Put your vehicle in neutral to save fuel.

en.explanation: When a Hill/Downgrade sign is present, you should slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and to save wear and tear on your brakes.

en.question: What background colors can a 'Bicycle Crossing Ahead' sign have?

choices.A: White or silver
choices.B: Red or orange
choices.C: Yellow or fluorescent yellow-green
choices.D: Green or blue

en.explanation: The manual states that the Bicycle Crossing Ahead sign may have either a yellow background or a fluorescent yellow-green background.

en.question: What is the difference in required driver response between a 'Set of Curves' sign and a 'Right and Left Sharp Turns' sign?

choices.A: A set of curves involves three or more curves, while sharp turns involve only two.
choices.B: A set of curves requires you to stop, while sharp turns only require yielding.
choices.C: Sharp turns require you to slow down substantially, while a set of curves requires you to slow down and prepare to navigate.
choices.D: There is no difference; they are used interchangeably.

en.explanation: For a 'Set of Curves', you must slow down and prepare to navigate. For 'Right and Left Sharp Turns', the road turns sharply, requiring you to 'slow down substantially' and prepare to navigate.

en.question: What should you do when you see a 'Divided Highway Ends' sign?

choices.A: Keep to the right of the centerline and watch for oncoming traffic.
choices.B: Prepare to merge into a single lane of one-way traffic.
choices.C: Keep to the left of the median.
choices.D: Accelerate to merge safely with highway traffic.

en.explanation: The 'Divided Highway Ends' sign means you will be on a roadway with two-way traffic. You must keep to the right of the centerline and watch for oncoming traffic.

en.question: How should you react when approaching a 'One Direction Large Arrow' sign?

choices.A: Maintain your speed and stay in the left lane.
choices.B: Slow down as much as you would to make a turn at an intersection.
choices.C: Come to a complete stop before proceeding.
choices.D: Accelerate to navigate the extreme angle safely.

en.explanation: The 'One Direction Large Arrow' indicates the road changes direction at an extreme angle. You should slow down as much as you would to make a turn at an intersection.

en.question: What does a 'Weave Area' warning sign indicate?

choices.A: The road surface is uneven and weaving is required to avoid potholes.
choices.B: You will be merging with another roadway as some traffic is exiting and crossing your path.
choices.C: The lane ahead ends and you must weave into the adjacent lane.
choices.D: Bicycles and pedestrians frequently cross the road ahead.

en.explanation: The 'Weave Area' sign is used to warn that you will be merging with another roadway as some traffic is exiting and crossing your path.

en.question: Why must you approach an intersection with extra caution when you see a 'Road Entering Curve' sign?

choices.A: The side road has the right-of-way over the main road.
choices.B: Traffic entering from the side road must merge into a new added lane.
choices.C: A driver entering the main road may not be able to see you approaching from around the curve.
choices.D: The curve is too sharp for vehicles traveling over 15 mph.

en.explanation: The manual states to approach with extra caution because a driver preparing to enter the main road may not be able to see you approaching from around the curve and may pull out in front of you.

en.question: Which of the following signs is the only pentagon-shaped sign used on the roadway?

choices.A: Stop sign
choices.B: Railroad crossing sign
choices.C: School zone sign
choices.D: No passing zone sign

en.explanation: The manual states that the school sign is the only pentagon-shaped sign used on the roadway, indicating you are approaching a school zone.

en.question: When traveling through a posted work zone, when are you required to turn on your headlights?

choices.A: Only at night
choices.B: Only when workers are actively present
choices.C: No matter what time of day
choices.D: Only if it is raining or foggy

en.explanation: The manual states you must turn on your headlights when traveling through a work zone, no matter what time of day, and it is the law for all posted work zones.

en.question: What is the additional fine if you are pulled over for a traffic violation in a work zone and your vehicle's headlights are not turned on?
en.explanation: If you are pulled over by police for a traffic violation in a work zone and your vehicle's headlights are not turned on, you will be fined an additional $25.

en.question: What colors are normally used for Work Zone signs?

choices.A: Yellow with black lettering
choices.B: Orange with black lettering
choices.C: Green with white lettering
choices.D: Red with white lettering

en.explanation: Work Zone Signs are normally diamond shaped, like warning signs, but they are orange with black lettering instead of yellow with black lettering.

en.question: What does a "Bicycle/Motor Vehicle Share the Road" sign indicate when placed at a roadway pinch point?

choices.A: Bicycles are not allowed on this section of the road.
choices.B: Motorists must provide adequate space for bicyclists because there is no shoulder or the lanes are narrow.
choices.C: Bicyclists must yield the right-of-way to motor vehicles at all times.
choices.D: There is a designated, separate bicycle lane ahead.

en.explanation: This sign is used at roadway pinch points (no shoulder, narrow lanes, etc.) to warn motorists to provide adequate space for bicyclists to share the roadway.

en.question: When approaching a marker for an object adjacent to the roadway, what do the downward-angled stripes indicate?

choices.A: The direction of the nearest highway exit.
choices.B: The direction you need to move to avoid the hazard.
choices.C: That you must come to a complete stop.
choices.D: That the road is closed ahead due to flooding.

en.explanation: Roadside objects and conditions are indicated by markers where the stripes are angled down in the direction you need to move to avoid the hazard.

en.question: How does the manual define an "active" work zone?

choices.A: Any area where orange diamond-shaped signs are posted.
choices.B: The portion of a work zone where workers are on the roadway or shoulder next to an open travel lane.
choices.C: A construction area where the speed limit is reduced to 25 mph.
choices.D: An area where heavy machinery is parked overnight.

en.explanation: An active work zone is the portion of a work zone where construction, maintenance or utility workers are on the roadway, or on the shoulder of the highway next to an open travel lane.

en.question: On Pennsylvania highways, what do the exit numbers correspond with?

choices.A: The year the exit was built.
choices.B: The speed limit of the exit ramp.
choices.C: The mile markers.
choices.D: The number of intersecting roads.

en.explanation: Exit numbers correspond with the mile markers. This change allows motorists to quickly calculate distances between exits.

en.question: What does a yellow panel with the message "EXIT ONLY" on a highway sign indicate?

choices.A: Only emergency vehicles may use the exit.
choices.B: The lane below the sign will not continue through the interchange and will form a ramp.
choices.C: The exit is closed for construction.
choices.D: You must increase your speed to exit safely.

en.explanation: If a yellow panel with the message EXIT ONLY is on a highway sign, the lane below the sign will not continue through the interchange; instead, the lane will go off of the road to form a ramp.

en.question: In the Interstate Numbering System, what do one- or two-digit even-numbered interstates generally indicate?

choices.A: North-south routes.
choices.B: East-west routes.
choices.C: Routes that connect directly to a city center.
choices.D: Routes that are currently under construction.

en.explanation: One or two-digit, even-numbered interstates are generally east-west routes.

en.question: What does a three-digit interstate highway number starting with an even number (such as I-276) usually signify?

choices.A: It is a spur route connecting at only one end.
choices.B: It is a route that travels exclusively north and south.
choices.C: It connects to interstate highways at both ends, often known as a loop or beltway.
choices.D: It is a toll road.

en.explanation: If the first of the three digits is an even number, the highway usually connects to interstate highways at both ends. Many times such routes are known as "loops" or "beltways."

en.question: How can you tell if an upcoming highway exit will be on the left side of the road?

choices.A: The exit sign will be painted entirely yellow.
choices.B: The small green exit number sign will be on the left side of the main rectangular sign.
choices.C: The exit number will be an odd number.
choices.D: There will be a flashing red light above the sign.

en.explanation: The small green EXIT number sign on top of the green rectangular sign will be on the left side of the sign, if the exit is on the left side of the highway.

en.question: What does it mean if an electric arrow panel in a work zone displays a "caution" message rather than a directional arrow?

choices.A: The road is completely closed ahead.
choices.B: You must immediately pull over to the shoulder.
choices.C: There is a work area ahead next to the travel lane.
choices.D: You are approaching a railroad crossing.

en.explanation: An arrow panel displaying a caution message indicates there is a work area ahead next to the travel lane. Drive with extra caution.

en.question: What color are most highway and expressway guide signs?

choices.A: Red with white letters
choices.B: Yellow with black letters
choices.C: Green with white letters
choices.D: Blue with white letters

en.explanation: The manual states that highway and expressway guide signs are green with white letters.

en.question: Which of the following are used in work zones to guide you through changing traffic patterns and keep you away from hazards?

choices.A: Electric arrow panels
choices.B: Pentagon-shaped signs
choices.C: Barrels, tubes, cones, and vertical panels
choices.D: Red, white, and blue shields

en.explanation: Barrels, tubes, cones and vertical panels are all channeling devices used in work zones to guide you through changing traffic patterns and keep you away from hazards associated with road work.

en.question: On east-west roadways in Pennsylvania, where do the mile marker numbers start at zero?

choices.A: In the eastern part of the state
choices.B: In the western part of the state
choices.C: In the center of the state
choices.D: At the largest city on the route

en.explanation: According to the manual, mile marker numbers start at zero in the western part of the state for east-west roadways and increase as you travel east.

en.question: What is a practical benefit of knowing how to read mile markers on the highway?

choices.A: They tell you the current speed limit of the highway.
choices.B: They indicate the exact distance to the next rest stop.
choices.C: They help you give an approximate location if you need to call for roadside assistance.
choices.D: They show the number of miles remaining to the next state border.

en.explanation: The manual states that knowing how to read mile markers can help you know exactly where you are and give an approximate location if you have to call for roadside assistance.

en.question: What color are service signs that show the location of hospitals, food, and lodging at the next exit?

choices.A: Green with white letters
choices.B: Blue with white letters or symbols
choices.C: Brown with white letters
choices.D: Yellow with black letters

en.explanation: Service signs are square or rectangular, are blue with white letters or symbols, and show the location of various services located at the next exit.

en.question: Which colors are typically used for tourist-oriented directional signs that direct motorists to museums or state parks?

choices.A: Red or orange with black lettering
choices.B: Green or yellow with black lettering
choices.C: Blue or brown with white lettering
choices.D: Black or white with red lettering

en.explanation: Tourist-oriented directional signs are square or rectangular and may be blue or brown with white lettering.

en.question: What is the primary purpose of yellow pavement lines?

choices.A: To divide lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction
choices.B: To mark the right edge of the road
choices.C: To divide traffic traveling in opposite directions
choices.D: To indicate a lane reserved for bicycles

en.explanation: The manual states that yellow lines divide traffic traveling in opposite directions, and are used to mark the center of two-lane roads.

en.question: Which pavement markings are used to divide lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction and to mark the right edge of the road?

choices.A: Solid white lines
choices.B: Broken yellow lines
choices.C: Solid yellow lines
choices.D: Double yellow lines

en.explanation: Solid white lines divide lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction and are also used to mark the right edge of the road.

en.question: What does a double, solid yellow centerline indicate on a two-way road?

choices.A: Passing is permitted for traffic in both directions.
choices.B: Passing is not allowed by traffic traveling in either direction.
choices.C: Only traffic on the right side may pass.
choices.D: The lane is reserved for left turns only.

en.explanation: A double, solid yellow centerline shows the center of a two-way road where passing by traffic traveling in either direction is not allowed.

en.question: When driving on a two-way roadway with a combination of a solid yellow and a broken yellow centerline, when are you permitted to pass?

choices.A: Only when the solid yellow line is on your side of the road
choices.B: Only when the broken yellow line is on your side of the road
choices.C: Whenever there is no oncoming traffic, regardless of the lines
choices.D: Passing is never permitted on this type of road

en.explanation: You may pass if the broken line is on your side of the road and safe conditions exist, but you may not pass when a solid yellow line is on your side.

en.question: On a three-lane or five-lane highway, what is the purpose of a center lane marked by inside broken yellow and outside solid yellow lines?

choices.A: It is a regular travel lane for passing slower vehicles.
choices.B: It is reserved exclusively for emergency vehicles.
